svg.text: The Levenshtein grid for kitten → sitting
Each cell holds the distance between the two prefixes that meet there. The answer is the bottom-right corner.
take the smallest of the three
The bottom-right corner is the answer: 3
substitute k→s, substitute e→i, insert g
That corner takes 2 from its left neighbour and adds 1 — an insertion. Its other two routes would cost 4 and 5.
Filling (n+1) × (m+1) cells costs O(n·m) time; keeping only the previous row cuts space to O(min(n, m)).
